metadata.notes: SCOPe dir.cla.scope 2.01-stable used as specified; no CATH substitution. SCOPe CLA provides no sequence, so sequence validation against a source expectation is not applicable; sequences are the parsed sliced-domain sequences.

filters.unit: SCOPe domain (defined residue segments, not whole entries)
filters.length_basis: segment-estimated length pre-filter; parsed sliced length enforced
filters.sampling: seeded shuffle (random.Random(seed)) of sorted superfamily ids, then of sorted domain ids within each superfamily; superfamilies contributed whole up to cap until pool size reached

metadata.resumability: Re-running skips cached CLA/entry CIFs and re-validates/reuses existing v3/domains/<domain_id>.cif files (existence + re-parse check) instead of re-slicing; entry cache may be deleted after a completed run and resumability still holds from sliced outputs alone, except failed candidates would need their entry again. Entries are parsed/sliced one at a time per worker; no bulk load.
